title: Storytellers Tall Base Sprites for MV

posts.author: LRDean_Socks
posts.body:
Storytellers is a project I've been trying to work on a while now in my personal time. It is a series of asset packs (mainly character packs) that I've been hoping to make. For those packs I have designed my own custom sprites. I am making the bases of these sprites available for others to use! They are designed to fit in MV as tall sprites, but I am hoping they will be usable in MZ as well.
​
Terms of Use:
(please read)
Non-Commercial Use
- Free to use
Commercial Use
- Free to use
(Contact me if you do, would to keep track and see how these get used in your wonderful projects)
Credit
- (Credit is required) You can credit
LRDean
or
LRDean a.k.a Socks
How to Credit
- The credit must be in the media itself. This means if you use these to make a game, then the credit needs to be in the game itself, not just on an external site about the game.
Reposts-
Must contain a link to this thread or other locations I have designated.
Edits
- You are allowed to make edits.
Posting Edits
- Please contact if your sharing edits. They must also have credit or link listed. When posting they need to on this site or other sites I have designated. You can contact me if you'd like to share them elsewhere.
About Sprite Pack
This is an ongoing collection of sprites, so be sure to be on the look out for updates to this set. I already have things like children sprites and animated emotes in the works. To use in MV be sure to add the $ to the beginning of the file names.
